findings.title: Oversized file (980 lines)
findings.evidence: 980 code lines - hard to hold in one head; a change here ripples widely.
findings.recommendation: Split into cohesive units by responsibility.

findings.title: Duplicated code blocks (1512)
findings.evidence: 1512 repeated 6-line blocks across 192 files.
findings.recommendation: Extract shared helpers; DRY the repeated logic.

findings.title: Empty catch block
findings.evidence: A `catch {}` silently discards errors.
findings.recommendation: Handle, rethrow, or at least log the error.

findings.title: File opened without context manager
findings.evidence: `open(...)` not wrapped in `with` - handle may leak on error.
findings.recommendation: Use `with open(...) as f:` for deterministic close.
